c: Open Problem › Create New. Incidents don't offer Create problem.
say: Open create new under problem. Incidents don't offer a way to create one.

c: Write the Problem statement and description; set the category, CI or service, impact and urgency.
say: Write a one line problem statement and a description, and set the category, the configuration item, impact and urgency.

c: Choose the group and a problem coordinator; only coordinators can be chosen.
say: Choose the assignment group, and a problem coordinator. Only coordinators can be chosen.

c: With an assignee it moves straight to Assess.
say: Save. With an assignee, it moves straight to assess.

c: Then link the incidents to it.
say: Then link the incidents to it.
